final: SELECT s1.team_id, s1.avg_ratio AS a, s1.cnt AS n_players, s1.avg_ratio - s2.avg_ratio AS a_minus_b FROM (SELECT t.team_id AS team_id, AVG(CAST(mh.w AS REAL) / mh.g) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(mh.player_id) AS cnt FROM team t LEFT JOIN manager_half mh ON mh.team_id = t.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(r.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(mh2.w AS REAL) / mh2.g) AS avg_ratio FROM team t2 LEFT JOIN manager_half mh2 ON mh2.team_id = t2.team_id GROUP BY t2.team_id) r) s2 WHERE s2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (s1.avg_ratio - s2.avg_ratio) IS NULL, (s1.avg_ratio - s2.avg_ratio) DESC LIMIT 10
